findings.body: When the original selection permits multiple nursery components and the result is grouped by `nursery_component`, the clicked cell adds a narrower component filter, but `componentKeys` is rebuilt by unioning values from both the original and cell filters. For example, selecting components A and B and clicking the A row leaves both A and B in the flattened component pin, so the shared Actual predicate can return B transactions and a total that does not match the clicked cell. Intersect the existing resolved component constraint with the clicked cell's descendant keys, preserving exclusions, and cover this through the production query entry point.
findings.title: Not done: Clicked component cells retain a matching pinned scope
